moment: The light is aimed. The word **OPEN** is held. The copy stands in the middle of the aim, and it will not move, and it will not speak, and the question is still in the air, and the seam will not finish the record until you answer it. P'taxx's paw is halfway to your shoulder. He has stopped breathing. The seam is waiting for you.
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, monochrome, no colour. Heavy blacks, high contrast, deep shadow, dark inked plate. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
